name: JalSetu
description: JalSetu is a hybrid IoT and community water safety network designed to prevent contamination and protect public health.
features: Community issue reporting with GPS and verified photo evidence
Hybrid IoT drift correction via Huber-Kalman sensor calibration
Real-time multi-responder geo-coordination across field teams
Explainable AI triage scoring prioritizing high-risk water points
Offline-first field operations with auto-sync on reconnection
Intelligent auto-resolve distinguishing verified fixes from silent sensors
target_audience: municipal water utilities, environmental departments, and community responders
call_to_action: Deploy JalSetu to secure your municipal water infrastructure today.
